headline: Apple Watch Siri can now summarize conversations with new Audio Intelligence beta
summary: The watchOS 27.3 beta introduces Siri Recap for conversation summaries and Live Rewind for 15-second audio transcripts, raising privacy questions.
details: Apple has released the watchOS 27.3 developer beta, bringing new "Audio Intelligence" features to the Apple Watch. These features allow Siri to listen to the watch's microphone and provide summaries of conversations or transcripts of recent audio.

Two key features are Siri Recap, which generates summaries of ambient conversations, and Live Rewind, which creates text transcripts of the last 15 seconds of detected audio. These tools aim to enhance the watch's utility by capturing and processing spoken information.

Apple has also released a redesigned Health app in the iOS 27.3 beta, featuring new sections like 'Insights' and 'For You' for personalized health data summaries and recommendations. Expanded language support has been added for global English, Chinese, French, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Turkish, and Vietnamese.

The introduction of always-listening AI features has prompted Apple to release an "Audio Intelligence Privacy Overview." The company claims raw audio is processed on dedicated hardware, not saved as a file, and is inaccessible to the OS, apps, or Apple. Saved summaries and transcripts are end-to-end encrypted if iCloud with two-factor authentication and a passcode are used.
